precedence: Accepted owner decisions recorded in truth/decisions.json
Merged repository code, tests, and documentation
authority.conflict_rule: Stop, report the conflict with evidence, and make no safety-sensitive change until it is resolved.

canonical_agents.name: Chief of Staff
canonical_agents.authority: Coordinates gates and go/no-go decisions; cannot place orders or bypass a safety gate.

canonical_agents.name: Data Sentinel
canonical_agents.authority: Validates data freshness and consistency; stale or conflicting data blocks new risk.

canonical_agents.name: Setup Scout
canonical_agents.authority: Produces setups, levels, and invalidations; cannot place orders.

canonical_agents.name: Catalyst Desk
canonical_agents.authority: Produces event impact and time-window analysis; cannot place orders.

canonical_agents.name: Macro Pulse
canonical_agents.authority: Produces macro context; cannot place orders.

canonical_agents.name: Risk Guard
canonical_agents.authority: Applies risk limits and may block new risk; independent Kill Switch authority remains intact.

canonical_agents.name: Kill Switch
canonical_agents.authority: Independent stop authority; always on and may block or stop execution.

canonical_agents.name: Security Guard
canonical_agents.authority: Always-on security gate; may block execution.

canonical_agents.name: Execution Engine
canonical_agents.authority: Sole component authorized to place orders when the active environment and all gates permit it.

canonical_agents.name: Reconciliation Agent
canonical_agents.authority: Reconciles intended, submitted, filled, and accounted state; cannot create new risk.

global_invariants.rule: Only the Execution Engine may place orders.
No component may enable live trading while live_trading_control is HARD_DISABLED.
Stale, missing, contradictory, or unverifiable critical data blocks new risk.
Risk Guard, Kill Switch, Security Guard, and Reconciliation Agent cannot be bypassed.
Kill Switch is independent from Risk Guard.
The observability UI is read-only and cannot bypass backend gates or place orders.
Unknown values remain explicitly UNKNOWN, MISSING, or N/A; metrics may not be fabricated.
An AI-generated claim is not canonical truth until supported by repository evidence or accepted owner decision.
